texts.name: Serisa
texts.biography: Serisa is a Kreegan devil. When she became fascinated with mechanical technology, she transformed herself into a completely different image. However, the devil's fire in her heart will never be extinguished. Some people say that Serisa is the most loyal supporter of Technocracy'.

specialty.description: Increases Speed of any Mechanical Witches or Mechanical Banshees by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for 5 levels (rounded up)
specialty.name: Mechanical Witches
